title: Case 178: The Woman Without a Face

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她曾被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏简·多伊。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“罪案档案呈现”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Walk down a lonely German street, particularly at night.
sentences.zh: 走在一条寂静的德国街道上，尤其是在夜晚。

sentences.en: If you do, you might feel something heavy jump on your back, weighing you down.
sentences.zh: 如果你这么做了，你可能会觉得有什么沉重的东西跳上你的背，让你步履维艰。

sentences.en: You can't shake off the creature, nor can you kill it.
sentences.zh: 你既无法甩掉这个生物，也无法杀死它。

sentences.en: According to German folklore, die Aufhochre, meaning leap upon, is a mythological shapeshifter that will hang on to you until you pass away from exhaustion or terror.
sentences.zh: 根据德国民间传说，“die Aufhochre”意为扑上，是一个神话中的变形怪，它会一直缠着你，直到你精疲力竭或惊恐而亡。

sentences.en: Variants to the legend say that the Aufhochre kills its victims by tearing out their throats.
sentences.zh: 该传说的其他版本说，“Aufhochre”会通过撕裂受害者的喉咙来杀死他们。

sentences.en: It can take the form of a goblin or a sad old lady, and in some cases, no shape at all.
sentences.zh: 它可以化身为地精或悲伤的老妇人，在某些情况下，甚至没有具体的形态。

sentences.en: The Aufhochre can never be caught, changing shape as it pleases and disappearing into the night.
sentences.zh: “Aufhochre”永远无法被抓住，它可以随心所欲地改变形状，并消失在夜色中。

sentences.en: It is said that church bells, sunlight, prayer, and profuse swearing may help to ward off the evil creature.
sentences.zh: 据说教堂的钟声、阳光、祈祷和大量的咒骂或许有助于驱赶这个邪恶的生物。

sentences.en: Another version of the Aufhochre lies in the legend of a beautiful young woman who preyed upon a border guard returning home after a long day at work.
sentences.zh: “Aufhochre”的另一个版本源于这样一个传说：一个年轻貌美的女子盯上了一名结束了一天辛勤工作、正在回家路上的边防警卫。

sentences.en: He spotted the woman, and as he approached, was attacked from behind by a force that he could not see, nor fight off.
sentences.zh: 他发现了那个女人，当他走近时，遭到了一股来自背后的力量的袭击，那股力量既看不见也无法抵抗。

sentences.en: The guard struggled and screamed before the attack suddenly ceased.
sentences.zh: 警卫拼命挣扎并大声尖叫，随后袭击突然停止了。

sentences.en: The beautiful woman disappeared, leaving the guard to wonder if he had even seen her at all.
sentences.zh: 美丽的女子消失了，留下警卫怀疑自己是否真的见过她。

sentences.en: Although the legend of the Aufhochre was derived from roots buried deep in German mythology, a real-life shapeshifter struck throughout Europe in the early 90s.
sentences.zh: 尽管“Aufhochre”的传说根植于德国神话深处，但在90年代初，一个现实生活中的变形怪在整个欧洲作案。

sentences.en: So pervasive was this woman who became known as the woman without a face that she travelled through multiple countries and murdered recklessly without ever being seen.
sentences.zh: 这个被称为“无脸女子”的女人无处不在，她走过多个国家，肆无忌惮地谋杀却从未被看到过。

sentences.en: She vanished every time, leaving few clues behind to mark her presence.
sentences.zh: 她每次都凭空消失，只留下很少的线索来证明她曾出现过。

sentences.en: The 62-year-old retired church warden lived alone in the German town of Ida-Ulberstein,
sentences.zh: 这位62岁的退休教堂管理员独自住在德国伊达-乌尔贝斯坦小镇，

sentences.en: 700 kilometres south-west of Berlin.
sentences.zh: 位于柏林西南700公里处。

sentences.en: Lieselotta made some lemon cakes and placed them in the oven to cook, in preparation for any houseguests that might visit.
sentences.zh: 利泽洛塔烤了一些柠檬蛋糕并放进烤箱里烹烤，为可能来访的做客者做好准备。

sentences.en: On her kitchen table lay a bouquet of flowers, tied neatly together with metal wire.
sentences.zh: 在她的餐桌上放着一束花，用金属丝整齐地捆绑在一起。

sentences.en: Three days later, Lieselotta's neighbour arrived at her home to chat over a cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 三天后，利泽洛塔的邻居来到她家，打算一边喝茶一边聊天。

sentences.en: She knocked on the front door.
sentences.zh: 她敲了敲前门。

sentences.en: There was no answer.
sentences.zh: 无人应答。

sentences.en: Finding a way inside, the neighbour came across Lieselotta's body on the floor.
sentences.zh: 邻居找到一条进去的路，在地板上发现了利泽洛塔的尸体。

sentences.en: Flowers littered the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 鲜花散落在餐桌上。

sentences.en: Around Lieselotta's neck was the metal wire that had been used to bind them.
sentences.zh: 利泽洛塔的脖子上缠着用来捆绑它们的金属丝。

sentences.en: She had been strangled with such force that the wire was embedded into her throat.
sentences.zh: 她被极其用力地勒住，以至于金属丝陷入了她的喉咙。

sentences.en: The brutality of the murder, coupled with the strength needed to overpower the victim and inflict her injuries, led police to assume that Lieselotta's killer was a man.
sentences.zh: 这起谋杀的残酷性，加上制服受害者并造成其受伤所需的巨大力量，让警方认为利泽洛塔的凶手是一名男性。

sentences.en: A thorough examination of the crime scene uncovered little in the way of evidence.
sentences.zh: 对犯罪现场的彻底检查几乎没有发现什么证据。

sentences.en: The wire was common, available for purchase from many hardware stores.
sentences.zh: 这种金属丝很常见，许多五金店都可以买到。

sentences.en: No foreign fingerprints or footprints were left behind by the killer.
sentences.zh: 凶手没有留下任何外来的指纹或足迹。

sentences.en: While left unharmed, Lieselotta's Yorkshire Terrier didn't make a peep around the time of the attack, which occurred on the morning she was found or the day prior.
sentences.zh: 尽管毫发无伤，但在袭击发生时——即她被发现的当天早晨或前一天，利泽洛塔的约克夏梗犬没有发出一点声音。

sentences.en: This led to speculation that Lieselotta knew her killer, or otherwise welcomed them inside, unsuspecting of any danger.
sentences.zh: 这让人推测利泽洛塔认识凶手，或者以其他方式欢迎他们进屋，对任何危险毫无防备。

sentences.en: Several items were taken into evidence, including a brightly coloured floral teacup that was sitting out in Lieselotta's kitchen.
sentences.zh: 几件物品被作为证据带走，其中包括放在利泽洛塔厨房里的一个颜色鲜艳的花卉茶杯。

sentences.en: A neighbour reported who they thought resembled a salesman leaving Lieselotta's house in the days before her body was found.
sentences.zh: 一名邻居报告说，在发现尸体的前几天，看到一个他们认为长得像推销员的人离开利泽洛塔的房子。

sentences.en: He was carrying a pilot's case and had a bodybuilder-like figure.
sentences.zh: 他提着一个飞行员箱，有着健美运动员般的身材。

sentences.en: Detectives focused on this lead, but the man was never identified.
sentences.zh: 侦探们把重点放在这条线索上，但该男子从未被确认身份。

sentences.en: Eight years passed and Lieselotta Schlanger's murder remained unsolved.
sentences.zh: 八年过去了，利泽洛塔·施兰格的谋杀案仍然未破。

sentences.en: On March 26, 2001, 61-year-old Josef Walsenbach was alone at his home in Freiburg in Breisgau,
sentences.zh: 2001年3月26日，61岁的约瑟夫·瓦尔森巴赫独自呆在弗赖堡布赖斯高地区的家中，

sentences.en: 300 kilometres south of where Lieselotta Schlanger was murdered.
sentences.zh: 距离利泽洛塔·施兰格被谋杀的地方以南300公里。

sentences.en: Josef lived alongside a small shop where he dealt antiques.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫住在一个经营古董的小店旁。

sentences.en: Hearing a knock at the door, Josef opened it and let the person on his doorstep inside.
sentences.zh: 听到敲门声，约瑟夫打开门，把站在门口的那个人迎了进来。

sentences.en: As he turned his back, Josef was hit over the head multiple times with a heavy object.
sentences.zh: 当他转过身时，约瑟夫被一个重物多次击打头部。

sentences.en: Police later found Josef Walsenbach's body on the floor of his home.
sentences.zh: 警方后来在约瑟夫·瓦尔森巴赫家中的地板上找到了他的尸体。

sentences.en: In addition to having his skull broken, Josef had also been strangled with a piece of garden wire.
sentences.zh: 除了头骨碎裂，约瑟夫还被一截园艺铁丝勒死。

sentences.en: 125 euros had been stolen from him.
sentences.zh: 他被偷走了125欧元。

sentences.en: A foreign DNA profile was found on Josef's body, presumed to have come from his killer.
sentences.zh: 在约瑟夫的尸体上发现了一个外来的DNA样本，推测来自他的凶手。

sentences.en: The same profile was also uncovered in his kitchen on a glass and in Josef's antique shop adjacent to his house.
sentences.zh: 同样的样本也在他厨房的一个玻璃杯里以及约瑟夫紧邻房屋的古董店里被发现。

sentences.en: Sampling found on the sign in the shop window indicated that the killer had been brazen enough to turn it from open to closed after carrying out the murder.
sentences.zh: 对店面橱窗标志上采集的样本表明，凶手在实施谋杀后表现得十分大胆，甚至将其从营业中翻转为打烊。

sentences.en: The DNA profile was run through Germany's national DNA database.
sentences.zh: 该DNA样本被输入了德国的国家DNA数据库。

sentences.en: As it was still in its infancy, the database did not locate a match.
sentences.zh: 由于该数据库当时尚处于初期阶段，并未找到匹配项。

sentences.en: However, the sample was uploaded in the hope of one day identifying Josef's killer.
sentences.zh: 然而，该样本还是被上传了，希望能有一天找出约瑟夫的凶手。

sentences.en: The sample itself was particularly intriguing.
sentences.zh: 这个样本本身非常耐人寻味。

sentences.en: While it was suspected that Josef's killer was a male, the DNA proved otherwise.
sentences.zh: 虽然怀疑约瑟夫的凶手是男性，但DNA证明并非如此。

sentences.en: It had come from a woman of Eastern European ancestry.
sentences.zh: 它来自一名具有东欧血统的女性。

sentences.en: Although separated by almost a decade, the similarities between the murders of Lise Lotte Schlanger and
sentences.zh: 尽管相隔近十年，但莉泽洛特·施兰格与

sentences.en: Josef Walsenbach were obvious.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·瓦尔森巴赫谋杀案之间的相似之处显而易见。

sentences.en: Both were aged in their 60s, lived alone and were strangled by wire.
sentences.zh: 两人都在60多岁，独居，且都是被铁丝勒死的。

sentences.en: Evidence taken from Lise Lotte's house was reexamined following Josef's murder.
sentences.zh: 在约瑟夫被谋杀后，从莉泽洛特家中提取的证据被重新检验。

sentences.en: A residual saliva sample from an unknown source was found on the floral teacup taken from her kitchen.
sentences.zh: 在从她厨房拿走的碎花茶杯上发现了一个来源不明的残留唾液样本。

sentences.en: When compared to the sample on file from Josef Walsenbach's murder, there was a match.
sentences.zh: 与存档的约瑟夫·瓦尔森巴赫谋杀案样本进行比对时，发现吻合。

sentences.en: The same unknown woman of Eastern European ancestry was present at both crime scenes.
sentences.zh: 同一个具有东欧血统的未知女性曾出现在两个犯罪现场。

sentences.en: After following up nearly 3,000 leads, authorities were unable to identify the woman.
sentences.zh: 在跟进了近3000条线索后，当局仍未能确认该女子的身份。

sentences.en: As with Lise Lotte Schlanger's case, the investigation into the murder of Josef Walsenbach went nowhere.
sentences.zh: 与莉泽洛特·施兰格的案件一样，对约瑟夫·瓦尔森巴赫谋杀案的调查也陷入了死胡同。

sentences.en: Over the following months, the mysterious woman went on a crime spree throughout Germany.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，这个神秘女子在全德国展开了一场犯罪狂潮。

sentences.en: In August 2001, police linked her DNA to several break-in enters of garden sheds 200 kilometres northeast of where Josef was murdered.
sentences.zh: 2001年8月，警方将她的DNA与约瑟夫被谋杀地点东北200公里处发生的几起花园棚屋入室盗窃案联系起来。

sentences.en: A month later, a caravan was broken into a further 200 kilometres north.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，更北200公里处的一辆房车遭到破门入室。

sentences.en: The wanted woman's saliva was found on a half-eaten biscuit.
sentences.zh: 通缉女子的唾液在一块吃了一半的饼干上被发现。

sentences.en: One month after the caravan break-in, a seven-year-old boy was walking near his home, 175 kilometres west, in the town of Gerolstein.
sentences.zh: 在房车被盗一个月后，一个七岁的小男孩在位于175公里以西的格罗尔施泰因镇家附近散步。

sentences.en: He stepped on a used syringe on a pathway, obtaining a needle stick injury.
sentences.zh: 他在一条小路上踩到了一支用过的注射器，导致针头刺伤。

sentences.en: The boy was taken to hospital and tested for the transmissible diseases HIV and hepatitis.
sentences.zh: 男孩被送到医院，并进行了人类免疫缺陷病毒和肝炎等传播性疾病的检测。

sentences.en: Results came back negative.
sentences.zh: 结果呈阴性。

sentences.en: The syringe contained trace amounts of heroin and a minute sample of blood.
sentences.zh: 注射器中含有微量的海洛因和一个极小的血液样本。

sentences.en: Test results revealed that the blood contained the same DNA profile as the woman who was suspected of murdering Lise Lotte Schlanger and Josef Walsenbach,
sentences.zh: 检测结果显示，血液中含有与涉嫌谋杀莉泽洛特·施兰格和约瑟夫·瓦尔森巴赫的女子相同的DNA图谱，

sentences.en: as well as breaking into garden sheds and a caravan.
sentences.zh: 同时也涉嫌闯入花园棚屋和房车。

sentences.en: It seemed as though she was an intravenous drug user, with the need to fund her heroin addiction offering a possible motive for her crimes.
sentences.zh: 她似乎是一个静脉吸毒者，需要维持海洛因瘾可能是她犯罪的动机。

sentences.en: Without any further clues to hint at her identity, she was henceforth known as
sentences.zh: 由于没有任何进一步的线索暗示她的身份，她此后被称为

sentences.en: The Woman Without a Face.
sentences.zh: “无脸女子”。

sentences.en: Over one year passed with no further crimes occurring that could be linked to The Woman Without a Face.
sentences.zh: 一年多过去了，再也没有发生可以与“无脸女子”联系起来的犯罪活动。

sentences.en: Then, in 2003, she re-emerged.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2003年，她再次出现。

sentences.en: 220 kilometres east of where her used syringe was found in Gerolstein lies the bustling town of Dietzenbach.
sentences.zh: 在她用过的注射器在格罗尔施泰因被发现的地点以东220公里处，坐落着繁华的迪岑巴赫镇。

sentences.en: On New Year's Day 2003, Dietzenbach police were called to a break-in at a downtown office building.
sentences.zh: 2003年元旦那天，迪岑巴赫警方接到报警，称市中心一处办公楼发生了一起入室盗窃案。

sentences.en: Nothing much was stolen, aside from some loose change.
sentences.zh: 除了零钱之外，没有偷走太多东西。

sentences.en: However, DNA recovered from the crime scene matched The Woman Without a Face.
sentences.zh: 然而，从犯罪现场提取的DNA与“无脸女子”相符。

sentences.en: She had returned after 15 months of inaction.
sentences.zh: 在沉寂了15个月后，她回来了。

sentences.en: A high-profile prosecutor who liaised with the police spoke of the Dietzenbach break-in, telling reporters,
sentences.zh: 一位与警方保持联系的高调检察官谈到了迪岑巴赫的盗窃案，他告诉记者：

sentences.en: It was a professional job, she left no fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 这是一次专业行动，她没有留下任何指纹。

sentences.en: But she did leave a scraping of skin, and that was enough to pin the job on her.
sentences.zh: 但她确实留下了一片皮肤碎屑，这就足以将这桩案子归咎于她。

sentences.en: A year later, in 2004, The Woman Without a Face's DNA was found yet again.
sentences.zh: 一年后的2004年，“无脸女子”的DNA再次被发现。

sentences.en: This time on a spring-loaded rifle used by a man to carry out a robbery in France.
sentences.zh: 这一次是在一名男子在法国实施抢劫时使用的一把弹簧步枪上。

sentences.en: It appeared that she was on the move across Europe.
sentences.zh: 看来她一直在欧洲各地流窜。

sentences.en: But, by May 2005, she was back in Germany.
sentences.zh: 但是，到2005年5月，她又回到了德国。

sentences.en: Earlier that month, a nomadic Romani man named Randolph attempted to shoot and kill his brother.
sentences.zh: 那个月早些时候，一个名叫伦道夫的罗姆游牧男子企图开枪杀死他的兄弟。

sentences.en: Police located the gun used by Randolph in the Rhine River, which winds its way through the city of WorMs.
sentences.zh: 警方在蜿蜒穿过沃尔姆斯市的莱茵河中找到了伦道夫使用的枪支。

sentences.en: DNA on a bullet was a match to the woman without a face.
sentences.zh: 一颗子弹上的DNA与无脸女子相吻合。

sentences.en: Worms was in close proximity to some of her previous crimes.
sentences.zh: 沃尔姆斯离她以前的一些犯罪地点很近。

sentences.en: Randolph was arrested and charged with attempted murder.
sentences.zh: 伦道夫被捕并被控谋杀未遂。

sentences.en: He testified that the gun had been given to him by his father years earlier.
sentences.zh: 他作证说这把枪是多年前他父亲给他的。

sentences.en: He could not think of how any woman could be connected to the firearm and its bullets in any way.
sentences.zh: 他想不出任何女性会与这把枪及其子弹有任何联系。

sentences.en: Detectives believed Randolph and the woman frequented the same Bohemian community, even if they didn't know one another or interact directly.
sentences.zh: 侦探们认为伦道夫和这个女人经常出入同一个波西米亚社群，即使他们并不认识或没有直接互动。

sentences.en: This explained how and why she moved back and forth across Europe and had ties to everywhere she visited, but never seemed to settle down in one spot for long.
sentences.zh: 这就解释了她如何在欧洲各地来回穿梭，以及为什么她与她去过的每个地方都有联系，却似乎从未在一个地方安定下来太久。

sentences.en: A year later, 120 kilometres away in the German town of Saarbrücken, an apartment was broken into.
sentences.zh: 一年后，在120公里外的德国萨尔布吕肯镇，一处公寓被破门入室。

sentences.en: Neighbours witnessed the offender enter the property and were able to provide a description to police.
sentences.zh: 邻居们目击了罪犯进入该物业并能够向警方提供描述。

sentences.en: It was a man with short brown hair, dark eyes, a large nose, and a thin vertical line of facial hair that ran from his lower lip to his chin.
sentences.zh: 那是一个留着短棕色头发、黑眼睛、大鼻子、从下唇延伸到下巴有一条细细垂直胡须的男人。

sentences.en: Police were stunned when DNA uncovered at the crime scene came back as a positive match to the woman without a face.
sentences.zh: 当在犯罪现场发现的DNA与无脸女子完全匹配时，警方惊呆了。

sentences.en: This revelation provided a possible answer as to why they had been so unsuccessful in tracking her down.
sentences.zh: 这一发现为他们为何在追踪她时屡屡受挫提供了一种可能的解释。

sentences.en: Investigators now suspected that their target identified as a man or donned a male disguise.
sentences.zh: 调查人员现在怀疑他们的目标认同自己为男性或进行了男性伪装。

sentences.en: A police spokesperson told the BBC,
sentences.zh: 警方发言人告诉英国广播公司：

sentences.en: Later that year, the woman's DNA was discovered yet again, this time in the Austrian village of Mauthausen.
sentences.zh: 同年晚些时候，这名女子的DNA再次被发现，这次是在奥地利毛特豪森村。

sentences.en: Like previous robberies, this one targeted a store.
sentences.zh: 与以前的抢劫一样，这一次的目标也是一家商店。

sentences.en: In this case, the woman had accomplices.
sentences.zh: 在这个案件中，该女子有同伙。

sentences.en: A gang of robbers set off an explosive device under a manhole cover near a large shopping centre.
sentences.zh: 一伙劫匪在大型购物中心附近的一个人孔盖下引爆了一枚爆炸装置。

sentences.en: The blast caused the windows of an electronics store to shatter, allowing the group to enter the premises and steal mobile phones before fleeing.
sentences.zh: 爆炸导致一家电子产品商店的玻璃窗碎裂，使该团伙得以进入店内并在逃跑前偷走手机。

sentences.en: Though DNA belonging to the woman without a face was found at the crime scene, no other foreign samples were found.
sentences.zh: 尽管在犯罪现场发现了属于无脸女子的DNA，但没有发现其他外来样本。

sentences.en: One of the gang members was eventually arrested for the robbery, but denied any knowledge of the woman and wouldn't offer any further information that could lead to her identity.
sentences.zh: 其中一名团伙成员最终因抢劫被捕，但否认认识该女子，并拒绝提供任何可能导致确认她身份的进一步信息。

sentences.en: She had somehow coerced or threatened her co-offenders to stay silent.
sentences.zh: 她不知通过什么方式胁迫或威胁了她的同案犯保持沉默。

sentences.en: Michelle Kieserwetter grew up in the small German town of Uber Weisbach,
sentences.zh: 米歇尔·基泽韦特在德国乌伯魏斯巴赫的小镇长大，

sentences.en: 350 kilometres south-west of Berlin.
sentences.zh: 位于柏林西南350公里处。

sentences.en: Upon finishing school, Michelle joined the police force.
sentences.zh: 中学毕业后，米歇尔加入了警察队伍。

sentences.en: She started training at age 19 and, once completed, joined the anti-terror unit of the German Federal Police.
sentences.zh: 她在19岁开始接受训练，完成后加入了德国联邦警察的反恐部队。

sentences.en: By age 22, Michelle was stationed in Heilbronn, a historic city close to where the woman without a face was known to strike.
sentences.zh: 到22岁时，米歇尔被派驻到海尔布隆，这是一座历史名城，靠近无脸女子出没的地方。

sentences.en: In April 2007, Michelle Kieserwetter was a drug squad officer working undercover.
sentences.zh: 2007年4月，米歇尔·基泽韦特是一名卧底缉毒警察。

sentences.en: On the 25th, she was on duty, driving her green and silver Series 5 BMW.
sentences.zh: 25日这天她正在执勤，驾驶着她的绿银相间5系宝马车。

sentences.en: Her policing partner, Martin Arnold, was riding in the passenger seat.
sentences.zh: 她的警务搭档马丁·阿诺德坐在副驾驶座上。

sentences.en: Just before 2pm, the pair stopped for lunch.
sentences.zh: 下午2点前不久，两人停下来吃午饭。

sentences.en: They pulled into a Theresien visa in Heilbronn, an open space used for flea markets and festivals that served as a parking lot when not in use.
sentences.zh: 他们把车开进海尔布隆的特蕾西恩草坪，这是一个用于跳蚤市场和节日的开阔场地，不用时用作停车场。

sentences.en: A short time later, witnesses heard multiple gunshots ring out from the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，目击者听到停车场传出多声枪响。

sentences.en: First responders found Michelle lying on the ground outside her BMW.
sentences.zh: 急救人员发现米歇尔倒在她的宝马车外面的地上。

sentences.en: She had been shot dead, execution style.
sentences.zh: 她被枪杀身亡，死状犹如行刑。

sentences.en: Martin had also been shot in the face, with a bullet lodging behind his right eye.
sentences.zh: 马丁的脸部也中枪，一颗子弹卡在他的右眼后面。

sentences.en: He was lucky to survive.
sentences.zh: 他很幸运地活了下来。

sentences.en: After waking from a month-long coma, Martin revealed that he couldn't recall anything in the lead-up to the attack.
sentences.zh: 在从一个月的昏迷中醒来后，马丁透露他记不清袭击前的任何事情。

sentences.en: A special task force titled Special Commission Parking Lot was established to investigate the shooting of the two police members.
sentences.zh: 一个名为“停车场特别委员会”的特别工作组成立，负责调查两名警察被枪击的事件。

sentences.en: Officers set up a dragnet, registering any vehicles within a certain radius of the crime scene,
sentences.zh: 警官们设置了封锁线，登记犯罪现场一定半径内的任何车辆，

sentences.en: in the hope that it would reveal any leads, while a forensics team went through Michelle's BMW.
sentences.zh: 希望这能提供任何线索，而法医团队则对米歇尔的宝马车进行了全面检查。

sentences.en: Both Michelle and Martin's service weapons and handcuffs were missing, presumed stolen by their attacker.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔和马丁的配枪和手铐都不见了，推测是被袭击者盗走。

sentences.en: The bullets fired upon the officers came from two different guns, indicating there were at least two offenders.
sentences.zh: 向警察开枪的子弹来自两支不同的枪，表明至少有两名罪犯。

sentences.en: The trajectory of the discharged bullets revealed that the gunman had entered the BMW via the rear doors and shot the officers point-blank from the back seat.
sentences.zh: 发射子弹的弹道显示，枪手是从后门进入宝马车，并在后座近距离射击了警察。

sentences.en: It happened so quickly that neither officer had time to draw their own weapons.
sentences.zh: 这一切发生得太快，以至于两位警官都没有时间拔出自己的武器。

sentences.en: Working on the theory that the crime was an act of revenge on the state police, investigators zeroed in on groups that would harbour such resentment.
sentences.zh: 基于这是一起针对州警察报复行为的理论，调查人员将目标锁定在会怀有这种怨恨的群体上。

sentences.en: They made inquiries with the local homeless and drug-affected communities, but failed to uncover any leads or rule anything out.
sentences.zh: 他们向当地的无家可归者和吸毒人群进行了调查，但未能发现任何线索或排除任何嫌疑。

sentences.en: It was brutal, apparently random, and with no apparent motive.
sentences.zh: 这是一起残忍的、显然是随机的、且没有明显动机的事件。

sentences.en: What are we dealing with here?
sentences.zh: 我们现在面对的究竟是什么？

sentences.en: And who is the accomplice?
sentences.zh: 同谋又是谁？

sentences.en: Special Commission Parking Lot received its first major lead in June, two months after the shooting.
sentences.zh: “特别委员会：停车场”在枪击案发生两个月后的6月份收到了第一条重要线索。

sentences.en: DNA samples taken from the center console and one of the rear armrests of Michelle Kizaveta's BMW came back with a match.
sentences.zh: 从米歇尔·基萨韦塔的宝马车中控台和一个后排扶手上提取的DNA样本比对成功。

sentences.en: The woman without a face had been implicated in yet another murder.
sentences.zh: 这个没有面孔的女人又牵涉进另一起谋杀案中。

sentences.en: Following this revelation, police ramped up their search to find the killer, who had earned the new moniker based on her latest crime, the Phantom of Heilbronn.
sentences.zh: 这一发现曝光后，警方加大了搜捕凶手的力度；根据她最新犯下的罪行，凶手被赋予了一个新绰号——“海尔布隆之幽灵”。

sentences.en: A reward of 10,000 euros, which was later increased to 15,000, was offered for any information leading to the identification of the Phantom.
sentences.zh: 警方悬赏1万欧元（后来增加到1.5万欧元），以征集任何有助于确认“幽灵”身份的信息。

sentences.en: The gang member who had worked with her previously to carry out a robbery of an electronics store in Mauthausen was interrogated yet again.
sentences.zh: 警方再次审讯了此前曾与她合作在毛特豪森抢劫一家电子产品商店的帮派成员。

sentences.en: Even with a reward on offer, he remained tight-lipped, leads dried up, and of the 18 homicides investigated by the Heilbronn police in 2007,
sentences.zh: 尽管有悬赏金，他依然守口如瓶，线索中断；在海尔布隆警方2007年调查的18起凶杀案中，

sentences.en: the murder of Michelle Kizaveta was the only one left unsolved.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔·基萨韦塔的谋杀案是唯一未破的悬案。

sentences.en: The Phantom of Heilbronn, however, was just getting started.
sentences.zh: 然而，“海尔布隆之幽灵”才刚刚开始行动。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案节目稍后回归。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目赞助商的广告，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持档案节目继续为您带来高质量的内容。

sentences.en: DNA from the Phantom of Heilbronn, or The Woman Without a Face, was found four months after the murder of Michelle Kizaveta.
sentences.zh: 在米歇尔·基萨韦塔遇害四个月后，人们在别处发现了“海尔布隆之幽灵”（又称“无面女”）的DNA。

sentences.en: It was located in a shared garden south of Heilbronn, following a series of house break-ins in the area.
sentences.zh: 该DNA是在海尔布隆南部的一个共用花园里被发现的，此前该地区发生了一系列入室盗窃案。

sentences.en: Nothing of major significance was stolen, only a few bottles of beer, some bell peppers, and a bunch of grapes.
sentences.zh: 并没有被盗走什么重要物品，只有几瓶啤酒、一些甜椒和一串葡萄。

sentences.en: Her DNA was found at other crime scenes, including the theft of a car and computer equipment from a school in the German town of Saarland,
sentences.zh: 她的DNA还在其他犯罪现场被发现，包括德国萨尔兰德镇一所学校发生的汽车和电脑设备盗窃案，

sentences.en: as well as a stolen car from Linz in Austria.
sentences.zh: 以及奥地利林茨的一起汽车盗窃案。

sentences.en: Anyone else arrested in relation to these crimes refused to name the Phantom.
sentences.zh: 任何因这些罪行而被捕的人都拒绝供认“幽灵”的身份。

sentences.en: On January 30, 2008, three men from the country of Georgia travelled to the German town of Happenheim, 80 kilometres north-west of Heilbronn.
sentences.zh: 2008年1月30日，来自格鲁吉亚的三名男子前往位于海尔布隆西北80公里处的德国哈芬海姆镇。

sentences.en: They had planned to buy used cars to transport home for resale.
sentences.zh: 他们原计划购买二手车运回家乡转售。

sentences.en: Their dead bodies were later fished out of the Rhine River after travelling 25 kilometres downstream.
sentences.zh: 他们顺流而下漂流了25公里后，尸体后来在莱茵河中被捞起。

sentences.en: Two men were quickly apprehended for the murders.
sentences.zh: 两名男子很快因谋杀罪被捕。

sentences.en: One of whom was working as a police informant.
sentences.zh: 其中一人曾是一名警方线人。

sentences.en: As reported in Crime Magazine, the informant had previously been given a station wagon by the local police,
sentences.zh: 据《犯罪杂志》报道，当地警方此前曾给过这名线人一辆旅行车，

sentences.en: which he used to transport the bodies prior to dumping them in the river.
sentences.zh: 他在将尸体抛入河中之前，就是用这辆车运送尸体的。

sentences.en: When forensics took swabs of the carpet, they also uncovered the Phantom of Heilbronn's DNA.
sentences.zh: 当法医对地毯进行擦拭采样时，也发现了“海尔布隆之幽灵”的DNA。

sentences.en: Her accomplices refused to give her up, instead implicating each other as being the killer.
sentences.zh: 她的同伙拒绝供出她，反而互相指控对方才是凶手。

sentences.en: The chief superintendent overseeing Special Commission Parking Lot told the Mirror publication,
sentences.zh: 负责“停车场特别委员会”的总警司对《镜报》表示：

sentences.en: We are as baffled as everyone else about how her DNA came to be there, but it is one more piece in the mosaic.
sentences.zh: “对于她的DNA是如何出现在那里的，我们和所有人一样感到困惑，但这是拼图中的又一块。”

sentences.en: All criminals, no matter how deadly or how clever, all slip up eventually.
sentences.zh: 所有的罪犯，无论多么凶残或多么聪明，最终都会露出马脚。

sentences.en: We just hope we catch her before she kills again.
sentences.zh: 我们只希望能在她再次行凶之前抓住她。

sentences.en: On October 22, 2008, 45-year-old Diana Pavlenko was completing chores in her home in Vinesburg, 6 kilometres east of Heilbronn.
sentences.zh: 2008年10月22日，45岁的戴安娜·帕夫连科在位于海尔布隆以东6公里处的温斯堡家中做家务。

sentences.en: After cleaning some dishes, the psychiatric nursing assistant locked up and left her house.
sentences.zh: 洗完盘子后，这位精神科护理助理锁好门离开了家。

sentences.en: Four days later, Diana's body was found near the hospital where she worked.
sentences.zh: 四天后，戴安娜的尸体在她工作的医院附近被发现。

sentences.en: The Phantom of Heilbronn's DNA was found in Diana's car.
sentences.zh: 在戴安娜的车里发现了“海尔布隆之幽灵”的DNA。

sentences.en: Coworkers described Diana Pavlenko as someone who was friendly and nice, but also extremely reserved.
sentences.zh: 同事们形容戴安娜·帕夫连科为人友好、随和，但也极其内向。

sentences.en: Nobody knew much about her private life, even though Diana had worked on the same ward for 20 years.
sentences.zh: 尽管戴安娜在同一个病区工作了20年，但没有人对她的私生活了解很多。

sentences.en: A neighbour spoke of seeing Diana only when she went onto the balcony to hang out washing.
sentences.zh: 一位邻居说，只有当戴安娜走到阳台上晾衣服时，才能看到她。

sentences.en: Otherwise, she remained indoors, usually with the blinds drawn.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，她一直待在室内，通常百叶窗都是拉上的。

sentences.en: Diana's murder offered investigators a rare opportunity to narrow in on a suspect.
sentences.zh: 戴安娜的遇害为调查人员提供了一个缩小嫌疑人范围的难得机会。

sentences.en: They theorised that the Phantom might have been a current or former patient at the hospital where Diana worked.
sentences.zh: 他们推测，“幽灵”可能是戴安娜工作的医院里的一名现任或前任患者。

sentences.en: The psychiatric ward treated 8,000 patients a year between the ages of 18 and 62.
sentences.zh: 该精神病区每年接待8000名年龄在18岁至62岁之间的患者。

sentences.en: Police interviewed some persons of interest at the facility, but privacy laws prevented them from accessing patient files that might have contained more valuable clues.
sentences.zh: 警方在该设施面谈了一些相关人员，但隐私法禁止他们查阅可能包含更有价值线索的患者档案。

sentences.en: The ward's chief physician was fairly dismissive that a female patient was responsible for the murder of his colleague.
sentences.zh: 该病区的主治医师相当不以为然，认为女患者不会是杀害他同事的凶手。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: “引述如下：

sentences.en: When Diana Pavlenko disappeared, she was off duty for a week.
sentences.zh: “当戴安娜·帕夫连科失踪时，她已经休假一周了。

sentences.en: During this period, no patient went into hiding.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，没有患者躲藏起来。”

sentences.en: At Diana's funeral, a witness noticed a peculiar and somewhat unnerving presence.
sentences.zh: 在戴安娜的葬礼上，一位目击者注意到了一种奇怪且有些令人不安的存在。

sentences.en: He described, quote,
sentences.zh: 他描述说，引述如下：

sentences.en: He said they were the type of people that he didn't want to meet in the dark.
sentences.zh: 他说，这是那种他不想在黑暗中遇到的人。

sentences.en: Despite the possible psychiatric ward lead,
sentences.zh: 尽管有精神病区的调查线索，

sentences.en: Diana Pavlenko's murder investigation reached the same conclusion as the others
sentences.zh: 戴安娜·帕夫连科的谋杀案调查结果与其他案件如出一辙。

sentences.en: It seemed as though authorities were always one step behind the Phantom, but were unable to catch a break.
sentences.zh: 似乎当局总是比“幽灵”落后一步，却始终无法迎来转机。

sentences.en: By the end of 2008, the Phantom of Heilbronn had been on the run for over 15 years.
sentences.zh: 到2008年底，“海尔布隆之幽灵”已经逍遥法外15年以上。

sentences.en: Her DNA was linked to nearly 40 major and minor crimes, ranging from small burglaries to murder, including that of police officer Michelle Kieserwetter.
sentences.zh: 她的DNA与近40起大小犯罪有关，从小偷小摸到谋杀不等，其中包括女警米歇尔·基泽维特的遇害案。

sentences.en: The Phantom's crime spree spread across Central Europe, with Germany her most popular location to strike.
sentences.zh: “幽灵”的犯罪足迹遍布中欧，其中德国是她最常作案的地点。

sentences.en: But she had also been linked to over a dozen crimes in Austria, another one of her frequent destinations.
sentences.zh: 但她也与奥地利的一十多起犯罪有关，奥地利是她另一个常去的地方。

sentences.en: Officials were left scratching their heads.
sentences.zh: 官员们对此百思不得其解。

sentences.en: While they had uncovered some leads in her transient lifestyle, drug use, and possible psychiatric treatment, there was only one certainty.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们在她居无定所的生活方式、吸毒史以及可能的精神科治疗方面发现了一些线索，但只有一件事是确定的。

sentences.en: The head of the Upper Austria State Criminal Police claimed,
sentences.zh: 奥地利上州刑事警察局局长声称：

sentences.en: The only hypothesis we're going to use is that it has to be a woman.
sentences.zh: “我们将采用的唯一假设是，嫌疑人一定是个女人。”

sentences.en: Several men had now been arrested in relation to crimes involving the Phantom, but their involvement was the tip of an iceberg.
sentences.zh: 如今已有数名男子因涉及“幽灵”的犯罪活动而被捕，但他们的涉案只是冰山一角。

sentences.en: Minute strands of male DNA had been uncovered at multiple crime scenes, suggesting the Phantom had accomplices from Albania,
sentences.zh: 人们在多个犯罪现场发现了微量的男性DNA，这表明“幽灵”拥有来自阿尔巴尼亚、

sentences.en: Croatia, France, Iraq, Poland, Romania, Serbia, and Slovakia.
sentences.zh: 克罗地亚、法国、伊拉克、波兰、罗马尼亚、塞尔维亚和斯洛伐克的同伙。

sentences.en: The same male DNA was never found twice.
sentences.zh: 同样的男性DNA从未被发现过两次。

sentences.en: The Phantom had a different accomplice for each crime she carried out.
sentences.zh: “幽灵”在她的每一次犯罪中都有不同的同伙。

sentences.en: In an article about the violent fugitive, the Sydney Morning Herald noted,
sentences.zh: 在《悉尼先驱晨报》关于这位暴力在逃犯的一篇报道中指出：

sentences.en: Highly regarded Viennese psychiatrist Dr. Kurt Kletzer had profiled many disturbing and dangerous individuals in his time.
sentences.zh: 备受尊崇的维也纳精神病学家库尔特·克莱策尔博士在其职业生涯中曾为许多令人不安且危险的个人做过心理侧写。

sentences.en: He was quoted in the mirror as saying,
sentences.zh: 《镜报》援引他的话说：

sentences.en: The Phantom is able to project an aura of normalcy while being anything but.
sentences.zh: “‘幽灵’能够展现出一种正常的外表，而实际上却完全不是那么回事。

sentences.en: She is compelled to murder to feed her drug habit, thus reducing the victim to the status of a worthless object.
sentences.zh: 她被迫杀人以满足其毒瘾，从而将受害者贬低为毫无价值的物品。

sentences.en: These psychopathic traits would have been formed at a very early age.
sentences.zh: 这些精神病态特质在很小的时候就已经形成了。

sentences.en: I would venture that the police are looking for someone from a damaged home life, perhaps a foster child or orphan, a child who was abused or whose carers were addicts.
sentences.zh: 我敢说，警方正在寻找的是一个家庭环境破碎的人，也许是寄养儿童或孤儿，是一个受过虐待或抚养人是瘾君子的孩子。

sentences.en: What doesn't fit at all is the murder of the policewoman and the attempted killing of her partner.
sentences.zh: 完全不合常理的是谋杀女警和企图谋杀她搭档的案子。

sentences.en: Unless they thought that they would have drugs, the act may be seen as the ultimate lashing out at authority.
